name: administer/sso-provider-setup
setup: a tenant with an OIDC provider for members named Acme Keycloak, off, with one passed try (ada, finance group)
ready: the Facts of the last try (Subject, Email, Groups) are shown
steps: open Tenant, then Single sign-on, then the provider
press Try signing in, sign in at the provider, close the tab, press Show the result
alt: A provider's Set up tab: the redirect address to enter at the provider, the sign-in address, and a Try signing in button with the facts the last try read.

name: administer/sso-branding-theme
setup: a tenant with ink-muted set to #cccccc in light and action set to notacolor
ready: the preview shows a list of pairs that are hard to read and a list of pairs that could not be checked
steps: type #cccccc in ink-muted (light) and notacolor in action (light)
alt: The Branding screen: the Portal panel, the light and dark token fields with their swatches, and the preview beside a list of pairs that are hard to read.

name: administer/sso-domains-details
setup: a tenant with the hostname portal.example.com serving the portal of a workspace, off and not verified
ready: the TXT record name and value are shown
steps: open Tenant, then Domains, then Details of the hostname
alt: A hostname's details sheet: what it serves, the three steps, the TXT record name and value to publish, and the Remove, Enable and Check now buttons.

name: administer/sso-workers-pools
setup: a tenant with a pool named warehouse and one standalone worker online for it
alt: The Workers screen: an empty queue, the table of pools with one pool that has a worker online, the line about workers the instance starts, and the credentials table.

name: administer/sso-audit-filters
setup: a tenant whose log has entries of a provider that was connected, tried and turned on
ready: the entry details are open and More filters shows Who, Action and Done to
steps: type the provider's name in Search
alt: The Audit log with its search box, area, since and workspace lists, More filters open, and the entry details beside the list.
